sentences.l2: 姉は絵を描くのが好きで、自分でTシャツを作っている。
sentences.l1: My older sister likes drawing pictures and makes T-shirts herself.

sentences.l2: まず紙にデザインを描いて、それを白いTシャツにプリントする。
sentences.l1: First she draws a design on paper, and then prints it on a white T-shirt.

sentences.l2: 使う色数は少ないが、世界に一つだけのオリジナルの服になる。
sentences.l1: The number of colours used is small, but it becomes an original piece of clothing that is the only one in the world.

sentences.l2: 友達にも作ってあげたら、とても喜んでくれた。
sentences.l1: When she made some for her friends too, they were very pleased.
